consumer.recovery: retry_startup_delay: while the WebSocket server cannot bind, the node logs a warning and retries application.listen(port, address) every retry_startup_delay seconds (code default 2.0 s; launch-file default 5) until it succeeds or the context is shut down. No recovery exists for the topic subscription itself: TopicNotEstablishedException / TypeConflictException raised while creating the subscription propagate to Protocol.incoming, which logs them as an error to the client and drops the request.
